description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application, responsible for rendering the home screen with a top menu, hero banner carousel, and multiple content rails. It includes detailed custom focus navigation to handle D-pad interactions, ensures scroll positioning on focus changes, manages data loading states, and inflates and updates UI components dynamically based on ViewModel state.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the home screen UI with focus navigation tailored for TV remote use, including a top menu, hero banner carousel, content rails, and integrated ViewModel state handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up focus navigation, binds data observers, and manages loading states.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Overrides key dispatch to track DPAD_UP navigation intent for focus scroll adjustments.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures top menu items with focus behaviors and DPAD navigation from top menu to hero banner.

methods.name: setupBannerCarousel
methods.description: Inflates banner cards, manages their loading, focus, and scroll positioning, and handles navigation between banner and other UI sections.

methods.name: computeCenterScrollX
methods.description: Calculates scroll X position to center a child view within a HorizontalScrollView.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Inflates, populates, and manages multiple content rails with focus remapping logic for DPAD commands within rails.

methods.name: moveFocusToHeroBanner
methods.description: Programmatically moves focus to the hero banner or its first child.

methods.name: moveFocusToFirstRailFirstItem
methods.description: Focuses the first item in the first content rail.

methods.name: ensureTopScrollIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the main ScrollView to top if focus enters hero banner due to DPAD_UP, ensuring the top nav is visible.

methods.name: isViewFullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a view is fully visible on the screen.
